title: Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.32259v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose \textit{HeteroFold}, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. translated_title: 面向异构多智能体大语言模型的无预填充跨模型家族KV缓存迁移
translated_abstract: 近期的多智能体大语言模型系统日益将异构模型组合以承担专业化的智能体角色。然而，基于文本的通信要求每个接收方对发送方已经处理过的共享上下文重新进行预填充。复用发送方的键值缓存可以避免这种冗余，但在不同模型家族之间进行无预填充的缓存迁移必须应对分词方式、模型深度和KV表示上的差异。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HeteroFold，一种无需预填充的跨模型家族KV缓存迁移方法，且发送方与接收方模型均保持冻结。HeteroFold对齐模型结构，将发送方缓存映射到接收方空间，并对其进行校准以保持接收方的原有行为。在六个迁移方向上，HeteroFold在全部四个长上下文基准以及大多数短上下文设置中取得了最佳的缓存迁移性能，并在多智能体基准上达到了与基于文本的通信相当的效果。在32K上下文长度下（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: HeteroFold提出了一种发送方与接收方均无需训练的无预填充跨模型家族KV缓存迁移方法，通过结构对齐、缓存映射与校准，使异构大语言模型之间可直接复用KV缓存，在长上下文基准上取得最佳迁移性能并达到与文本通信相当的多智能体效果。
en_tdlr: HeteroFold enables prefill-free, cross-family KV cache transfer between frozen heterogeneous LLMs by aligning model structures, mapping and calibrating the sender's cache, achieving the best transfer performance on long-context benchmarks and matching text-based communication on multi-agent tasks.
